claims.text: Infosys provides end-to-end business solutions to enable clients to enhance business performance across various business segments.

references.quote: The Group's operations predominantly relate to providing end-to- end business solutions to enable clients to enhance business performance.
Accordingly, information has been presented along business segments.

claims.text: Earlier, the revenue growth guidance for financial year 2027 was 1.5% to 3.5% growth year-on-year in constant currency terms.

references.quote: Our revenue growth guidance for the financial year 2027 is 1.5% to 3.5% growth year -on-year in constant currency terms.

claims.text: Later, the revenue growth guidance was changed to 1.5% to 3% Y-on-Y growth in constant currency terms.

references.quote: With our Q1 results and a view for the rest of the financial year, we are changing our revenue growth guidance to 1.5% to 3% Y-on-Y growth in constant currency terms.

claims.text: If client spending and investments continue to move towards AI, it could support transformation objectives during economic uncertainty.

references.quote: With our clear AI strategic roadmap and our real-world toolkit of Topaz Fabric, we are well positioned to support our clients' transformation, technology and operations objectives.
We expect client spending and investments to continue to move towards AI in the near term.

claims.text: If competitive intensity and AI productivity impact persist, they could weigh on traditional IT services.

references.quote: We also see continued competitive intensity and we see an AI productivity impact, a combination of these things.
Radical transformation in technology led by AI is shifting the dynamics of discretionary spending and mounting pressure on traditional IT services.
